description: List a repo's issues. Optional state filter (open/closed/all).

provider.description: The provider to read issues from, one of the ids orient lists: 'github' or 'gitlab' (per repository), or 'jira' or 'linear' (across the whole tracker), e.g. 'jira'.

repo.description: The repository name without the organisation, e.g. 'parthenon', the flagship repo, which is used when omitted; ignored by 'jira' and 'linear'.

state.description: Filter by state, one of 'open', 'closed' or 'all', e.g. 'closed'; when omitted the provider's own default applies.

name: list_issues
title: List issues
